items.title: Noah Cook Interview, 1960-09-06
items.q: Burt Williams took the preacher and the bear from Billy Kersan's.

ctx.x: That's the end. Burt Williams took the preacher and the bear from
Billy Kersan's. Yeah he took it from him. I heard

him sing. I love Burt Williams. Yeah. What did he do? I say I love Burt Williams songs you know. Oh yeah. He sings nice songs. Yeah he's fine. Nice. He's a nice show. Yeah I like one of his songs I picked a lemon in the garden of love. Yeah. We were just talking about that.
